scope: Three public alert checks; facts only.

alerts.feed: Michigan Senate Rogers and El-Sayed news
alerts.title: 700 doctors endorse Abdul El-Sayed as GOP attacks his credentials - The Detroit News

publisher_body_check.finding: Google RSS target redirected to consent.google.com; captured body is consent/sign-in page, not Detroit News article. No publisher publication timestamp, story text, signer names, or 700-person list verified. Did not attempt consent/cookie workaround.

primary_campaign_check.finding: Campaign directory says 130+ local/national leaders; no 700-doctor list/text found, so it does not verify this claim.

alerts.classification_of_evidence: Endorsement headline, not poll/ballot/candidate status; article/list unavailable.

alerts.title: Michigan heckler the son of Republican adviser paid for ‘influencer marketing’ against El-Sayed
alerts.finding: Guardian reports Thomas Teepell heckled El-Sayed at Flint Oct 17; Breakthrough LLC received $250,000 from America Next Sep 29 for opposition canvassing/influencer marketing, per FEC. No evidence Thomas was paid or Rogers campaign was involved; article has no poll result.

primary_filing.finding: FEC Form 5/Schedule 5-E lists filer America Next Inc (ID C90015439), transaction Sep 29 2026, payee Breakthrough LLC, $250,000, candidate EL-SAYED, ABDUL, purpose CANVASSING AND INFLUENCER MARKETING. Form is an independent-expenditure report and certifies expenditure was not coordinated with candidate/committee/party. No payment to El-Sayed or evidence he was involved.

alerts.classification_of_evidence: Third-party opposition spending; not poll, ballot, or candidate-status change.

alerts.title: Trump faces rare red state challenges over cost of living
alerts.finding: CBS VideoObject title matches alert; description says Trump rallied in Kansas Oct 19, criticized Democrats, and backed Sen. Roger Marshall; Weijia Jiang reports. Captured body contains no poll figures, no ME-02, CA-06, or NY-01 measurement, and no ballot/candidate-status change.

coverage_limit: Bounded to these alerts; Detroit News body/list remains unavailable.
